# TODAY

> The TODAY Show's digital hub for news, lifestyle content, shopping deals, and live event experiences from NBC's flagship morning program.

TODAY is NBC's premier morning show featuring anchors Savannah Guthrie and Craig Melvin, broadcasting live from Studio 1A at Rockefeller Center. The site combines news and entertainment content with a robust shopping and deals platform (TODAY Steals & Deals) and lifestyle events.

## About TODAY & Editorial

- [About TODAY: Our Team, Anchors, Editorial Policies and Contact](https://www.today.com/about/today/about-today-nbc-rcna150631): About page detailing TODAY show team, anchors Savannah Guthrie and Craig Melvin, and editorial policies.

## Shopping & Deals

- [TODAY Steals & Deals | Shop the Latest Deals | Deals We Love](https://deals.today.com): TODAY Steals & Deals shopping hub offering discounts on jewelry, fashion, and beauty products.

## Home & Lifestyle Awards

- [Better Homes and Gardens Clean House Awards Winners for 2026](https://www.today.com/shop/better-homes-gardens-clean-house-awards-winners-2026-rcna263745): 2026 Clean House Awards winners featuring top cleaning products like Pink Stuff and Scrub Daddy.
- [Shop TODAY Stages 2026: Health and Wellness with Brooke Shields](https://www.today.com/specials/stages-march-2026/index.html): Women's health and wellness event in Hudson Valley featuring Brooke Shields and brand experiences.

## Live Events & Visitor Information

- [Join the TODAY Show Live on the Plaza!](https://www.today.com/information/today-show-live-plaza-nyc-rcna260637): Guide for attending TODAY Show live at Rockefeller Center Plaza in NYC with visitor information.
